description: 黑象弃后双将，一步将死
explanation_en: Black's bishop uncovers the queen's line for a double-check checkmate in one.

intro.popup: 💡 双将：黑方先走，黑象在e7，黑后在e8，白王在e1。一步双将将死白王！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Double check: Black to move. The bishop is on e7, the queen on e8, and the white king on e1. Black can checkmate with a double check in one move!

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：...Bb4#双将！象攻e1对角线，揭开黑后e列将军，白王被自己的棋子困死！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: ...Bb4# is a double check. The bishop attacks e1 along the diagonal and uncovers the queen's check down the e-file, while White's own pieces trap the king.

moves.popup: 双将将死！黑象从e7跳至b4，象沿对角线攻e1，同时揭开黑后e8沿e列直指e1！白王被自己棋子团团围住，无路可逃。
moves.popup_en: Double-check checkmate! The bishop jumps from e7 to b4, attacking e1 along the diagonal and uncovering the queen's attack down the e-file. White's own pieces leave the king with no escape.
